facts.fact: 好消息：风暴已正式移出外海，Simone 顺带夸了一嗓子 Mother Nature。
facts.anchor: The storm has officially moved out to sea!

facts.fact: 安全预防仍在：港内设施关闭至次日早晨，清洁队通夜清除残骸；还在外面的人须找接驳车回 villa。
facts.anchor: We’re closing all harbor facilities until the morning so cleanup crews can work overnight to remove any debris.

facts.fact: 岛上部分地区停电，主要集中在 Tranquil Cove 一侧。
facts.anchor: we do have some power issues on certain parts of the island, mainly on the Tranquil Cove side

facts.fact: 广播安抚孩子："别担心，你父母没事"——还打趣说烛光对大人来说再浪漫不过。
facts.anchor: Don’t worry, your parents are just fine.

facts.fact: Simone 以"signing off for now"结束本次广播。
facts.anchor: This is Simone, signing off for now.
